scope: New formal-paper admission; accepted legacy paper inputs remain immutable.

shape_rules.entry.proof_target: Required JSON boolean for every new inventory entry.
shape_rules.entry.content_mapping: Every inventory entry resolves to exactly one actual content result. A different result ID requires explicit merge_target_id or merge_id; inventory_ids alone cannot silently rename the target.
shape_rules.issue.kind: Required nonempty source classification, preserved as author metadata; it does not implicitly select the display category.
shape_rules.issue.issue_type: Required explicit stable display category, selected by the mathematics author. A whole-statement counterexample requires original_statement_status=counterexample_verified; a compound-clause counterexample requires compound_clause_counterexample_verified.
shape_rules.issue.source_refs: Required nonempty array with source_id, version_id and nonempty positive-integer pdf_pages, matching the actual formal paper metadata and page range.
shape_rules.issue.result_links: Required nonempty affected_result_ids or related_result_ids, resolving to actual results that link back through related_issue_ids.
shape_rules.entry.non_proof_reason: Required nonempty source-grounded sentence when proof_target is false; software does not establish its mathematical reasonableness.
shape_rules.inventory.proof_targets: Optional list of target result IDs, or objects with id and inventory_ids; if supplied it must exactly agree with per-entry booleans.
shape_rules.result.lean: Object with explicit evidence_role and declarations array; report_path is required when declarations are claimed.
shape_rules.shared.lean: Same explicit role and declaration/report binding as result.lean; a related report is not automatically evidence for this shared proposition.
shape_rules.shared.translations: Object with en overlay; strict bilingual validation checks the actual title, conditions and proof steps.
shape_rules.paper.sources[].id: Source identity is id in paper metadata and source_id in inventory/source references.
shape_rules.mathematical_claims: External numbered theorems, false statements and substantive unnumbered derivations stay in the target denominator. Definitions containing a proof must be split or classified as a target.
shape_rules.text_control_characters: All new input strings reject C0 controls other than ordinary prose newline/tab or a CRLF line ending, and reject DEL. Fields ending in _tex additionally reject tab and all carriage returns, including list values. This catches Python escape corruption such as backspace from beta, formfeed from frac and a standalone carriage return from rho; it does not establish source or mathematical correctness.
shape_rules.lean.evidence_role: An explicit reviewed machine evidence role, independent of the source parent statement assessment. A complete counterexample to one clause may coexist with a partially-refuted parent; finite-domain components with only a human counterexample remain partial_component. Old scope-status wording cannot silently override a new paper role.
